Necessary Axioms (Manchester):
SubClassOf: BFO:SpecificallyDependentContinuant
SubClassOf: defectOccursOn some IOF:MaterialProduct
Notes / Assumptions: Defines a defect as an effect inhering in (occurring on) a material product.

Equivalent Class (Necessary & Sufficient: EquivalentTo: IOF:ProcessCharacteristic and (IOF:describedBy some ParameterObservation) and (IOF:prescribedBy some ParameterSpecification)
Notes / Assumptions: Links the process characteristic to its measurement and specification.

Equivalent Class (Necessary & Sufficient: EquivalentTo: IOF:MeasurementInformationContentEntity and (IOF:describes some ParameterCharacteristic) and (IOF:isAbout some ParameterSpecification) and (observationOf some IOF:MaterialProduct)
Notes / Assumptions: May also use 'ObservationOf some IOF:MaterialProduct' if desired.

Equivalent Class (Necessary & Sufficient: EquivalentTo: IOF:RequirementSpecification and (IOF:prescribes some ParameterCharacteristic) and (IOF:isSubjectOf some ParameterObservation)
Notes / Assumptions: Captures the USL/LSL/nominal via data properties on the spec individual.

Necessary Axioms (Manchester):
SubClassOf: prov:Activity
SubClassOf: hasAssessmentInput some ParameterObservation
Equivalent Class (Necessary & Sufficient:
EquivalentTo: 
  prov:Activity 
  and (hasAssessmentInput some ParameterObservation)
  and (hasAssessmentInput some ParameterSpecification)
  and (prov:generated some FailureCause)
Notes / Assumptions: Assessment activities generate failure-cause conclusions based on measurement inputs.

Necessary Axioms (Manchester):
SubClassOf: BFO:SpecificallyDependentContinuant
SubClassOf: affects some IOF:MaterialProduct
SubClassOf: prov:wasGeneratedBy some ConformanceAssessment
SubClassOf: isCorrectedBy only CorrectiveAction
Equivalent Class (Necessary & Sufficient: EquivalentTo: BFO:SpecificallyDependentContinuant and (affects some IOF:MaterialProduct) and (prov:wasGeneratedBy some ConformanceAssessment) and (RO:RO_0002566 some Effect)
Notes / Assumptions: Treats every FailureCause as a kind of Cause that affects a product and is produced by an assessment.
Pairs an action spec with at least one failure cause it corrects.
Uses the provided RO property orientation: Effect -> RO:causallyInfluences -> Cause.

Equivalent Class (Necessary & Sufficient: EquivalentTo: BFO:Quality and (IOF:describedBy some ParameterObservation) and (IOF:prescribedBy some ParameterSpecification)
Notes / Assumptions: Quality that is measurable and specifiable; specific units/values are data properties on the spec/meas.
